description: This file defines a PHP class TextHelperService providing string manipulation helper methods such as calculating string length, checking substring containment, and verifying string start/end matches. It is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Core service namespace, and includes methods that depend on PHP's mbstring extension and fallback implementations.

classes.name: TextHelperService
classes.description: Provides string manipulation utility methods such as calculating string length, checking for a substring, and string start/end checks. Designed for internal use within the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: strLength
methods.description: Returns the length of a string, supporting multibyte encodings via mb_strlen if available, or fallback to strlen.

methods.name: strContains
methods.description: Checks if $needle is contained within $haystack, using str_contains if available, or strpos fallback.

methods.name: strStartsWith
methods.description: Checks if $haystack starts with $needle, using str_starts_with if available, or strncmp fallback.

methods.name: strEndsWith
methods.description: Checks if $haystack ends with $needle, using str_ends_with if available, or substr_compare fallback.
